# Useful Links

## Teaching Resources

- [Cheat Sheets for R packages](https://opensource.posit.co/resources/cheatsheets/)
    - [Convenient set of cheat sheets used for Stat 1080 (introductory statistics) at USU](https://srvanderplas.github.io/stat1080/demos/r-cheat-sheets.pdf)


### Teaching R with `decoder`

Kelly Bodwin created a [series of puzzles](https://github.com/kbodwin/decoder) to reinforce different introductory R concepts. 

- [Indexing, matrix/vector creation, introductory debugging](https://github.com/kbodwin/decodeR/tree/master/Base_R)

- [Writing functions and ciphers](https://github.com/kbodwin/decodeR/blob/master/general/general-Puzzle.Rmd)

- [Data Cleaning with `dplyr`](https://github.com/kbodwin/decodeR/blob/master/dplyr/dplyr-Instructions.Rmd)

- [Solving Crimes with `lubridate`](https://github.com/kbodwin/decodeR/blob/master/lubridate/lubridate-Puzzle.Rmd)

- [Regression Diagnostics and Looney Tunes](https://github.com/kbodwin/decodeR/blob/master/regression/regression.Rmd)

- [Joins with `tidyr` and Military Spending](https://github.com/kbodwin/decodeR/blob/master/tidyr/tidyr-Puzzle.qmd)

## Books and Inspiration

- Observe, Collect, Draw! A Visual Journal, by Giorgia Lupi & Stefanie Posavec [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/Observe-Collect-Draw-Visual-Journal/dp/1616897147), [Author's site](https://giorgialupi.com/observe-collect-draw/)
  - Dear Data, by Giorgia Lupi & Stefanie Posavec [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/Dear-Data-Giorgia-Lupi/dp/1616895322/), [Author's site](https://giorgialupi.com/dear-data)
  
- Drawing Data with Kids, Cultivating Data-Literacy: A screen-free journey through the art of visualization for kids, by Gulrez Khan [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/1088205798/), [Author's site](https://drawingdatawithkids.com) -- includes free activities for classes

- Math with Bad Drawings, by Ben Orlin [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/Math-Bad-Drawings-Illuminating-Reality/dp/0316509043), [Author's site](https://mathwithbaddrawings.com)
    - Math Games with Bad Drawings, by Ben Orlin [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/Math-Games-Bad-Drawings-Challenging/dp/0762499869/)
    
    
- [The Big Book of R](https://bigbookofr.com) - A collection of free online R books

- [R for Data Science](https://r4ds.hadley.nz) - Book focusing on data science packages, by Hadley Wickham (author of `ggplot2`, `dplyr`, `tidyr`, ...)

- [Statistical Computing in R and Python](https://srvanderplas.github.io/stat-computing-r-python/) - textbook for UNL (and soon USU?) statistical computing courses

    
## Public Data Sources


- **Tidy Tuesday** is an R organization that posts a new public data set every week, and has since 2018. You can find the [data](https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday#datasets), but there are also people who [livestream analyzing the data](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=%23tidytuesday), and those videos are on YouTube and are an excellent way to learn how to use the `tidyverse` set of packages (which include `ggplot2`)


- [Utah GIS Data](https://opendata.gis.utah.gov) - maps, landmarks, demographics, climate, economy, energy, farming, geoscience, health, history, political science, recreation, society, transportation, utilities, and water. 

- [Data.gov](https://data.gov) - more than 500k datasets from the US government
  - Lake Powell [Releases](https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/lake-powell-glen-canyon-dam-and-powerplant-daily-lake-reservoir-release-total-cfs-time-ser?from_%3D%3D) and [Reservoir Elevation](https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/lake-powell-glen-canyon-dam-and-powerplant-daily-lake-reservoir-elevation-ft-time-series-d?from_%3D%3D)
  - Great Salt Lake [Bathymetry: Elevation, Area, and Volume tables](https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/great-salt-lake-elevation-area-volume-tables?from_%3D%3D)
  - EnviroAtlas Salt Lake City
    - [1 $\text{km}^2$ resolution data on the proportion of impervious surfaces](https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/enviroatlas-salt-lake-city-ut-impervious-proximity-gradient?from_)
    - Tree cover along [walkable roads](https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/enviroatlas-salt-lake-city-ut-estimated-percent-tree-cover-along-walkable-roads?from_) and [busy roads](https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/enviroatlas-salt-lake-city-ut-estimated-tree-cover-along-busy-roads?from_)
    
  - [Supply Chain Greenhouse Gas Emission Factors](https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/supply-chain-greenhouse-gas-emission-factors-v1-3-by-naics-6?from_hint=eyJzb3J0IjoicG9wdWxhcml0eSIsInEiOiIiLCJzcGF0aWFsX2ZpbHRlciI6Im5vbi1nZW9zcGF0aWFsIn0%3D)
  
  - [Meteorite Landings](https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/meteorite-landings?from_hint=eyJzb3J0IjoicG9wdWxhcml0eSIsInEiOiIiLCJzcGF0aWFsX2ZpbHRlciI6Im5vbi1nZW9zcGF0aWFsIn0%3D)
  
  - [CDC WONDER: Cancer Statistics](https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/cdc-wonder-cancer-statistics?from_hint=eyJzb3J0IjoicG9wdWxhcml0eSIsInEiOiIiLCJzcGF0aWFsX2ZpbHRlciI6Im5vbi1nZW9zcGF0aWFsIn0%3D)
  
  - [Baby Names from the Social Security Administration](https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/baby-names-from-social-security-card-applications-national-data?from_hint=eyJzb3J0IjoicG9wdWxhcml0eSIsInEiOiJiYWJ5IG5hbWVzIiwic3BhdGlhbF9maWx0ZXIiOiIifQ%3D%3D)
